cues.rawText:
* who lives in a pineapple
under the sea? *

* absorbent and yellow
and porous is he. *

* if nautical nonsense be
something you wish... *

* then drop on the deck
and flop like a fish. *

It is the early morning
in bikini bottom

When the jellyfish
are buzzing about

We made a net
especially for you.

Do you want
to come with us?

Oh, that would be
the best day ever in my book.

I would love to
go jellyfishing.

I can't think of anything i'd
love to do more on my day off

You know, Patrick,
it always seems

Like Squidward never
has time for fun.

And we're going
to make sure

He's greeted by
his two best friends.

Sure not going
to be out there.

How about some soup
on your best day ever?

How about some music
on your best day ever?

Played on your
very own clarinet?

Sorry, my lips
are a little dry.

Is what we saved
for last--

The one sure-Fire thing
to make your best day ever

Where wild jellyfish roam
just waiting to be captured.

But you don't even
have your net.

While i find him
a good specimen.

Firmly grasp it
in your hand.

Go! Go, squid!
You got it!
You got it.

Go, go, go!
Yes, you got it!

I think we
better show him
how it's done.

Go, squid,
get 'em, squid!
Squidster,
you're doing it!

All the way, take
him all the way.

This is really
your best day
ever, isn't it?

I thought yesterday went
pretty well, don't you think?

You're not still
mad, are you?
One crabby patty for table two.

Spongebob, i don't
have the whole day!

Oui, oui, une crabby patty,
monsieur.

Mister Krabs' gift to all of bikini
bottom-- The crabby patty.

I swear, i'm not
doing anything.

Hear me, krabs-- When i discover
your formula for crabby patties
I'll run you out of business.

Oh, i'll let you go,
squirt...

Back to the chum bucket
with you!

To steal me secret
formula for years.

But ye haven't got it
yet, have ye, bug?

Enough, lad,
it wasn't that funny.

Okay, Mister Krabs,
see you tomorrow.

Come on, boy,
a little closer.

You could say
we're friends, right?

Well, we're both invertebrates,
aren't we?

I've been keeping it
in my secret compartment.
And it's even got my name on it.
And you know what i'd like

More than anything
in the whole wide world?

What i want for my birthday
from you, my friend

You just want
to be friends

So you can get your hands
on a crabby patty!

And i bet it's
not even your
birthday tomorrow!

Gee, and i thought
you were stupid.

You'll never get a
crabby patty from me!
Oh, i'll get a crabby patty.

And you're going to hand-Deliver
it to me personally!

* ...letters of the alphabet,
a, b, c... *
It should be in here somewhere.

This will be the beginning
of the end.

That's it, brain,
you're going down!

And now, for my very elaborate
and college-Educated plan.

And now it's time
for a little wakey-Uppy.

I... i feel
a little funny today.
This isn't what i had in mind.
Let me just grab my pants.

I guess i'm not wearing
any pants today.

Oops! I guess i'm not
using the door, either.
See you later, gary... i guess.

You're right, gary, there is
something wrong with me!
Wake up! I need some help!

Shut your mouth, you mediocre
clarinet player.

Your snivelly creations
are worth less

Something must be wrong
with my brain!

What kind of
friend are you?

Nonsense! You never
liked me, anyway.

You wouldn't even come
to my birthday party!

You want
the crabby patty formula!

You are going to hand-Deliver it
to me personally.

And did i ever show you
my record player?

There, you see
how much easier it is
How do you like my analyzer?

It tells the ingredients
of whatever i put into it.

Now let's reveal
that secret formula.

And this little piggy
brought home a crabby patty.

This little piggy
will help me drop it in.

I just have to say i'm sorry
i let Mister Krabs down.
I let all of bikini bottom down.
But worst of all, i let you down

I'll never forget
your 100% all-Secret patty

Plankton: one percent evil,
99% hot gas.

Well, patty, i guess
we can go home now.
Give it back, you porous freak!
